Any of these breaks the ~9% EPS growth path the 17.2x rests on. A completed Nutrition spin before the horizon would mechanically lower the quote by ~$8.5 without breaking the thesis; adjust the level to ~$71 in that case.

model_inputs.structure_note: Value is carried by the 3-year segment driver build (Medical Devices, Diagnostics incl. Exact Cancer Dx, Nutrition, EPD; segment margins from 10-K note 16; corporate cost incl. SBC in corporate_ebit), valued on the build's own NTM figures with P/E 17.2x (weight 0.6) and EV/EBITDA 13.3x (0.4). EBIT is Abbott's adjusted basis (excludes amortization of acquired intangibles and specified items; SBC costed), the same basis as peers' consensus P/E; ebit_basis is 'gaap' only so the engine does not subtract SBC twice. No DCF leg (ABT is not a neocloud). Litigation (Q3 NEC deal, DOJ settlement, remaining NEC claims, Libre 3 claims) enters as equity adjustments, ~-$1.73B expected. The Nutrition spin is kept consolidated: a completed spin is value-neutral to holders but lowers the ABT quote, so it enters the ladder as a 12% branch, not the fair value. No SOTP leg: no filing-based nutrition/generics peers in the run table.
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) 17.2x horizon P/E is 8.5% below the 11-peer median 18.8x (each 1x ~ $6.3/share). (2) 13.3x EV/EBITDA equals today's level and the peer trailing median rolled forward. (3) Remaining NEC claims -$700M after tax vs the supervisor's -$950M (I read the August deal as ~$35k per infant after Gill). (4) Net debt is still the 2026-06-30 10-Q figure; the Q3 10-Q is due in the window. fair_value.value equals the engine's base horizon value.

ABT trades ~16.7x my NTM EPS today (98.4 / (0.2 x 5.53 + 0.8 x 5.99) = 98.4 / 5.90), so 17.2x assumes only ~3% re-rating as the guide reset is digested.
